# Copilot Instructions

- Before every repository task, read the root `AGENTS.md` and `docs/agents/SAFETY.md`.
- Follow `AGENTS.md` as the canonical repository guidance; inspect implementation and tests rather than assuming documentation claims are implemented.
- Never weaken authentication, tenant isolation/RLS, financial invariants, or data-handling boundaries to make a task pass.
- Ask before production-impacting or destructive actions.
